name: GLM
why: I think this makes GLM so much better an experience for me.

quotes.quote: I think this makes GLM so much better an experience for me.
quotes.excerpt: I think the self-doubt might actually be a very crucial part of it's capability. I often feel compelled to interrupt when I'm watching it think (which thank the stars it let's us do, unlike the big American models!!), but usually it makes the right pick! Being willing and able to reconsider seems very good. Going around and around, pulling in more thinking, integrating it: maybe that's why it is as good as it's good.
quotes.story: GLM-5.2 is the step change for open agents

quotes.quote: GLM, yes I use it, mostly for code review.
quotes.excerpt: GLM, yes I use it, mostly for code review. I do code review, take the analysis and pass it to Opus for implementation, Relatively cheap, has good statistics

quotes.quote: I use GLM/Kimi for everything else.
quotes.excerpt: Hey man, here's how to properly spend your 50 bucks and get the most bang for the $$: opencode go - $10 a month gets you decent allowance with latest GLM, MiniMax, and Kimi. Windsurf - $20 gives u access to nearlly all models. For me, I'm having these two subscriptions plus: shared Codex plans & shared Kimi coding Allegretto from Chinese resellers for around $10. I only use the Claude Opus/Sonnet inside Windsurf afte
quotes.story: Ask HN: $50 monthly budget, which coding models would you recommend now?

threads.title: Ask HN: What default model do you use and why?
GLM-5.2 is the step change for open agents
Ask HN: $50 monthly budget, which coding models would you recommend now?

quotes.quote: in obvious I usually use the GLM models
quotes.excerpt: I use a lot of different harnesses, so in CC i use sonnet as main w/ opus advisor, in codex i use astra all the time, in obvious I usually use the GLM models. In general I've found that having a fast main model with a big smart advisor is a nice UX if I'm going to be on keyboard interacting with it, for a long-running agent that I'm not attending to I care much less about the main model speed and more about cost/qual
